Preserve current authentication, tenant boundaries, deep links, subscriptions and operator-managed model/provider/infrastructure policy. Models/context/usage remain visible where truthful; privileged provider credentials, local installs and runtime administration stay operator-owned. OSS retains configuration. Read-only/disabled hosted variants must explain actual availability, never silently remove the requested component from the traceability map.

Selective source copies from packages/ui production modules under shared/vendor/assistant-ui, required runtime packages declared explicitly, retained MIT notices and hashes. No docs demos, workstation absolute paths or full monorepo imports. Export elements/* and typed runtime adapter contracts, using @assistant-ui/react@0.15.22. Preserve full donor Thread export and expose source-derived ThreadTranscript without composer/footer, with source-derived UserMessage and AssistantMessage override slots plus direct ThreadPrimitive/MessagePrimitive/ComposerPrimitive exports. Provide ThreadMessages composition when Gideon owns viewport. FM02 uses ThreadTranscript within ChatPage and keeps ComposerStage exactly once. Root serializes package.json/lock changes.

Gideon stores and transports stay authoritative. One useExternalStoreRuntime provider bridges ChatTurn[]/incremental segments and existing send/stop/edit/regenerate/queue/approval. Queue adapter must preserve existing steer/queue behavior. Branching uses actual messageRepository/setMessages or delegated Gideon variant/fork controls; flat history cannot claim working branches.

Typed registry dispatches actual tool/artifact/run payloads to donor components. Stable session/run/tool/message/artifact IDs required. Unknown confidence/cost/usage stays unknown; no invented values. Every interactive control maps to existing real action and resulting status.

Twenty-two UISpec template structures need an explicit typed renderer/adapter; Gideon GenUiWidget uses a different parseGenUi DSL. Never assume interchangeable formats. Production payloads replace example records. Source producers and action routes must be traced and qualified per template.

Preserve legacy hash routes and all214 mapped surfaces. Shared navigationModel owns route IDs; App owns dispatch; NavRail gets onSearch from explicit palette state. apps collection and apps/manage installation remain distinct and reachable.

Hosted web experience inside Windows Electron, adapting existing desktop package. Windows hosted mode never requires or starts a POSIX local backend. Existing Mac/Linux local runtime behavior retained.

resources/hosted-config.json contains schemaVersion:1, mode:hosted, hostedUrl:<validated HTTPS origin>. Build takes GIDEON_CLOUD_URL from explicit operator configuration; never guess a production hostname. Missing configuration fails build/start clearly. Authentication stays existing hosted web flow with return route preserved.

Windows x64 NSIS executable, Gideon product identity/icon, checksum manifest, installation/start/uninstall evidence. Build cross-platform through Node script; use Windows runner for native qualification. No update server or signing claim without configured service/credentials.

Remote hosted content never gains Node integration or privileged local preload. Origin/navigation/media/download/external-link policies use existing Electron boundaries. This is required correct desktop behavior, not a new product administration flow.

Specs first. Root owns authoritative statuses/contracts and main integration. Managers integrate assigned isolated feature branches; sixteen workers own bounded task branches. One task per worker, no duplicate review agents. Start claims only after planning and governance prerequisites pass.

Each checkout stays isolated; preserve preexisting modifications. Qualified worker -> manager via cg fleet merge-up -> root main via cg fleet land. Leader alone pushes OSS origin/main as integrated commits land. Hosted commits remain local. Current phase has no production deploy or service replacement.

Cross-feature prerequisites are explicit in master task graph; manager may not dispatch because a local mirror omits another feature task. Root unlocks consumers only once vendor/dependency/runtime contracts are committed.

A final commit cannot contain its own hash. Field is full git write-tree content hash of staged code, never a made-up commit ID. Resulting commit SHA is recorded separately in evidence.

Every committing agent uses independent persisted round-robin sequence 0,1,2,3,0... across both repositories and worktrees. Increment only after successful commit; serialize allocation. Author and committer use same assigned identity. Manager merges and leader landings rotate too.
